name: DDNeRF
definition: A method that increases sampling efficiency along rays during training by learning a more accurate representation of the density distribution along rays. It trains a coarse model to predict the internal distribution of transparency (as Gaussian parameters) in addition to total density, which guides the fine model's sampling.
summary: DDNeRF is a neural volume rendering method that improves sampling efficiency by modeling coarse probability density functions as mixtures of truncated Gaussians instead of discrete piecewise-constant distributions.
